subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept bare `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` as session-naming shortcuts, or should naming stay behind the existing `/name` command or an explicit named-new syntax?
rationale: The code reuses the existing `label` contract, but it intentionally changes user-facing command grammar that overlaps current `/new [model]` expectations and the broader open named-new command work.

options.title: Accept Control UI Shortcuts
options.body: Land the Control UI-specific shortcut semantics with docs explaining that `/model` handles model changes.

options.title: Require Explicit Naming Syntax
options.body: Ask the branch to preserve bare `/new` expectations by using `/name`, `/label`, or `/new --name` for naming.

options.title: Defer To Broader Command Work
options.body: Pause this PR and settle named-new semantics in the broader command PR before landing this surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Control UI Shortcuts
recommendation.body: Land the Control UI-specific shortcut semantics with docs explaining that `/model` handles model changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the accepted `/name` command direction and are the strongest routing owner for the command/session UX decision.
